hypotheses: Dactolisib at 1 uM for 24 h in A375 may produce a reproducible histone perturbation >0.5 log2 vs vehicle, with the strongest anchor-line signals involving H3K9me2K14ac1, H3K56me0, H3K9me1K14ac0, H3K79me1, H3K18ac0K23ac1, and H3K9me3K14ac0.
Donors with high anchor similarity to dactolisib in A375 are more likely to transfer a measurable target-minus-A375 response for the selected MCF7 feature BI10043 (H3K27me3K36me0) with sign -1.
The fixed external decoder may select MCF7 feature BI10043 with sign -1, so donor pharmacology should be retrieved for compounds whose measured A375 histone profiles are closest to dactolisib.

TG101348, SP600125, afuresertib, CC-401, and losmapimod are prioritized because they have the highest positive anchor similarities among candidate donors and are therefore the most plausible measured reference donors for transfer.
No viability or causal claim is made; the goal is only to identify donor IDs whose pharmacology descriptions should be retrieved to support a reproducible histone perturbation analysis.
object.evidence_gap: The provided data do not include measured histone response values for the candidate donors in A375 or MCF7, so donor selection is based on anchor similarity and model diagnostics rather than direct donor response measurements. Pharmacology descriptions for the selected donors are needed to assess whether their mechanisms are compatible with the observed dactolisib anchor profile and the decoder-selected MCF7 feature.
